summary: The ansible-navigator text-based UI mode works with IDEs like VS Code and offers colon commands (:run, :collections), jumping to a line with :<number>, colour-coded output (deprecated modules in red), and pagination and scrolling. You cannot switch modes once navigator is running.
questions: How do I use colon commands in ansible-navigator?
Can I switch ansible-navigator modes while it is running?
How do I jump to a line number in ansible-navigator?
Why are some modules shown in red in ansible-navigator?
